nom: COSRX The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with cystic acne, report the serum absorbs well without feeling greasy and left skin less oily than usual.
segments.dry: A reviewer whose skin is dried out by tretinoin and spironolactone reports the serum restores plumping hydration and eases tight, dry skin.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin, made severely dry by acne medication, reports the texture is non-greasy and hydrating rather than heavy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers repeatedly describe sensitive, reactive, or actives-intolerant skin and report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, with one exception warning against combining it with a moisturizer.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s report firmer, plumper, more youthful-looking skin with softened fine lines and improved neck/jawline firmness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report firmer, plumper skin, softened fine lines/crow's feet, and improved neck and jawline firmness after two to four weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Nearly all reviewers report noticeable hydration and plumpness, including one whose skin was dried out by tretinoin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports reduced redness after repeated use; no other reviewer reports redness as an issue.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer explicitly credits the serum with supporting her compromised skin barrier while on tretinoin and spironolactone; no barrier damage is reported by others.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or acne marks over two to three weeks; one reviewer found spots more noticeable due to overall skin brightening rather than fading.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts and some reduction in existing blemishes or scarring; one reviewer states her acne is still present though looking better.
concerns.oiliness: Two reviewers with oily skin report the serum absorbed well and left skin feeling less oily; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Possible irritation when layered with moisturizer

extraits.texte: So far I like this. However, be careful if you have sensitive skin. Maybe don't pair it with the moisturizer. By itself, it is nice thiugh

extraits.titre: A Gentle Serum with Visible Firming Benefits
extraits.texte: I've been using COSRX The Blue Peptide Serum daily on my face and neck for the past month, and the biggest improvement I've noticed is in my neck. The skin on my neck looks firmer, smoother, and more toned, with less visible sagging than before.I've also seen some improvement in the firmness of my face, especially around my jawline. The serum has a lightweight, comfortable texture that absorbs quickly and feels great on my skin.I have sensitive skin and experienced no irritation, redness, or breakouts during use. My before-and-after photos show the noticeable difference, especially in the appearance of my neck. Overall, I'm very happy with the results and will continue using it.

I've only been using this serum for about three weeks now, but so far I'm really impressed. I have sensitive, acne-prone, and milia-prone skin, and it hasn't triggered any irritation, breakouts, or milia.This serum leaves my skin looking plump, hydrated, and radiant. The texture is on the thicker side, but it spreads effortlessly and absorbs beautifully without feeling heavy or sticky.My skin has always loved COSRX products, and this new Blue Peptide serum is no exception. It's beautifully formulated, feels luxurious on the skin, and the vibrant blue color makes it stunning to look at. While it's still early, this serum has quickly become a favorite in my routine.

extraits.titre: glassy, milky, plush little cloud skin :cloud:

My skin just drinks it up instantly :sob::blue_heart: it feels like pure plumping hydration and leaves my face looking juicy, smooth, and fresh instead of coated or oily.Like genuinely glassy, milky, plush little cloud skin :cloud:I've been using this product for 2 weeks now. Calm, juicy, luminous??like it finally drank water after wandering the desert for 3 business days :sob::blue_heart:

extraits.titre: Best plumping and smoothening serum that works overnight!
extraits.texte: The blue bottle is power packed with amazing clean ingredients that actually work. I have tried other brand but none showed such quick results.The first night I used, I woke up with plump face, smooth texture and it did not cause any irritation to my cystic acne, instead calmed it down.There is a glass like texture that radiates from the skin.The serum spreads evenly. It's not overly sticky nor oily but my extremely oily skin absorbs it pretty good.The dropper is convenient and the bottle has a seal that even if it falls by mistake, the serum doesn't fall it, saving your money. Phew! It's an amazing design.I would definitely buy it again and it has become regular part of my routine. As an oily skin girly with cystic acne and new emerging fine lines, this gave me glass skin that's pump and glowy.

THIS is my new favorite serum! It has a great consistency and texture - not too thick and not too thin. It goes on smoothly and absorbs into the skin well, leaving my skin hydrated and smoother. It has reduced fine wrinkles, making my skin look more youthful and radiant. It doesn't have a scent either. My daughter has sensitive skin but this serum has been gentle enough for her to use. She's young so she has a lot of acne but since using this serum, her acne has reduced 50%!!

I have sensitive, acne-prone oily skin and when I say this serum is out of this world, trust me, it is. My skin feels moisturized and firm after almost 2 weeks of use. The color of the serum is very stable and hasn't changed at all.Get this serum, it has amazing benefits, even for sensitive skin.
